hero.description: Milestis gives you rigid, unbreakable layouts so every project you build looks premium — regardless of your experience.

rigid.title: Rigid Design — Quality by Default

rigid.handleDesc: Structure, proportions, typography, spacing — fully engineered presets.
rigid.controlDesc: Content, palette, atmosphere, decorations — your creative freedom.

atmosphere.title: Atmosphere & Personal Touch
atmosphere.description: Add depth to any project with textures, light effects, and decorative elements. Layer cinematic overlays, place ornaments across the page, combine everything with a curated color palette — and the project becomes unmistakably yours.

platform.title: Built for Real-World Sharing
platform.subtitle: Every project published through Milestis is a fully interactive digital presentation — accessible from any link.

instant.title: Opens in an Instant
instant.description: Anyone you share the link with gets an instant-loading experience — no app, no download, no friction.

responsive.title: Responsive on Every Screen
responsive.description: Whether opened on a phone, tablet, or large display — every project adapts and always looks its best.

upToDate.title: Always Up to Date

professionals.title: A Tool for Photographers & Creators
professionals.description: Stop delivering a folder of files. With Milestis, you hand over a finished, branded digital product. A powerful upsell that increases your average order value — and makes clients remember you.
